name: The Prophet Isaiah
overview: The Prophet Isaiah, son of Amoz, ministered during the reigns of several kings of Judah, delivering visions concerning Judah and Jerusalem (Isaiah 1:1). His prophetic call reveals a majestic vision of the Lord enthroned, emphasizing God's holiness and sovereignty (Isaiah 6:1). Isaiah was commissioned by God to confront King Ahaz with a message of hope, including the promise of a miraculous sign: a virgin shall conceive and bear a son named Immanuel, pointing to the coming Messiah (Isaiah 7:3, 7:14). This child is further described as the Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, and Prince of Peace, highlighting the divine nature and eternal reign of Christ (Isaiah 9:6). Ultimately, Isaiah’s message culminates in a call to praise God for His mercy and comfort, even after judgment (Isaiah 12:1).
